title: ID0463241-DC/Si-D/FR-[RVP/T2170004605] Lock mechanism not unlocking
description:
Reported behavior/issue-
Charging issue
Solution: EV issue -> EV is the responsible for locking the system
On several occasions, people have been unable to disconnect the charging cable from their car. We encountered this issue today on connector number 2 between 10:00 AM and 1:30 PM (see charger log). We had to send a technician. After switching off the charging station, the vehicle lock indicator, which was red, turned white, and the cable could then be disconnected. Can you check if any action needs to be taken on this station or other stations of this type to prevent the problem from recurring?

additional_info.subject: ID0463241-DC/Si-D/FR-[RVP/T2170004605] Charging issue CRM:03056000556
additional_info.body:
Hello Thimon, good morning.
Thank you for raising this issue, but
the charger is not responsible for the locking mechanism
. The EV is the one that decides when to lock and unlock from the system.
Here is the excerpt from the international norm regarding this subject:
I will wait for your feedback before closing the ticket, as the problem lies on the EV side. I can provide you a photo of our own test car's CCS inlet and show you how it looks like, as soon as I can get it.
Thank you!
Best regards,
Francisco
